about: Public test data only: every key is derived from a label and used nowhere else.  Section 16 of docs/muster-ios/server-route-spec.md prints the vectors of keys, canonicalForm, pin, history, reopen, lists, listBodyHashes, approvals, answers (the answer objects and their bodySHA256) and illustrativePlan, and a test checks that this file still equals the spec's text.  Everything else was made by running muster_approval.py and fleet-ops-control.py themselves: answers[].line and lineSHA256 (the whole answer line, one canonical-JSON line and a line feed), badSignatures, generatedAnswers, generatedPlans and resourceFieldScales.  To regenerate this file, run python3 scripts/make_muster_vectors.py --write; a test regenerates it and fails when it differs, so it cannot drift from the code.  The chain slice must read the T-lists and entry hashes from the spec text, section 16: chainVectors holds only each vector's id and its expected answer, and the 50 or so hashes of the chain vectors are not here.
